articles.title_en: Earnings, Marriage, and the Variance of Family Income by Age, Gender, and Cohort
articles.title_cn: 收入、婚姻与家庭收入方差随年龄、性别和队列的变化
articles.abstract_en: For birth cohorts 1935–44, 1945–62, and 1964–74, we estimate the contribution of education; permanent heterogeneity in wage rates, employment, and hours; labor market shocks; spouse characteristics and shocks; nonlabor income shocks; and marital histories to the age profiles of the variance of family income per adult equivalent. Education and employment heterogeneity are key sources of the rise in variance with age and across cohorts. Wage heterogeneity is important at all ages. Own characteristics and shocks matter more for men than women, while spouse characteristics and shocks matter more for women. Gender differences have declined across cohorts.
articles.abstract_cn: 对于出生队列1935-44、1945-62和1964-74，我们估计了教育、工资率、就业和工作时间的永久异质性、劳动力市场冲击、配偶特征和冲击、非劳动收入冲击以及婚姻史对按成人等价计算的家庭收入方差年龄曲线的贡献。教育和就业异质性是方差随年龄增长和跨队列上升的关键来源。工资异质性在所有年龄段都很重要。自身特征和冲击对男性的影响大于女性，而配偶特征和冲击对女性的影响更大。性别差异在队列间有所下降。

articles.title_en: Interpreting Cohort Profiles of Life Cycle Earnings Volatility
articles.title_cn: 解读生命周期收入波动的队列剖面
articles.abstract_en: We present new estimates of earnings volatility over time and the life cycle for men and women by race and human capital, using Social Security earnings linked to the Current Population Survey. From the late 1970s to the mid-1990s, there is a strong negative trend in earnings volatility driven by a decline in transitory variance. From the mid-1990s, there is relative stability in trends of male earnings volatility due to an increase in the variance of permanent shocks. Cohort analyses indicate that earnings volatility is U-shaped, driven by large permanent shocks early and later in the life cycle.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用与社会保障收入相关联的当前人口调查数据，按种族和人力资本分组，对男性和女性随时间及生命周期的收入波动提出了新的估计。从1970年代末到1990年代中期，收入波动呈现强烈的负趋势，这主要是由暂时性方差下降所驱动。从1990年代中期起，男性收入波动趋势相对稳定，原因是永久性冲击的方差增加。队列分析表明，收入波动呈U形，由生命周期早期和晚期的较大永久性冲击所驱动。

articles.title_en: Workers’ Perceptions of Earnings Growth and Employment Risk
articles.title_cn: 工人对收入增长和就业风险的感知
articles.abstract_en: In addition to realized earnings and employment shocks, forward-looking individuals are presumed to condition their consumption and labor supply decisions on their subjective beliefs about future labor market risks. This paper uses rich panel data to document considerable individual heterogeneity in earnings growth expectations and in the perceived likelihood of voluntary and involuntary job exits. We examine how expectations evolve over the working life and business cycle and how they covary with macroeconomic expectations and personal experiences. While largely consistent with patterns in realized outcomes, our findings highlight the unanticipated nature of the pandemic recession and the ensuing resignation wave.
articles.abstract_cn: 除了已实现的收入和就业冲击外，前瞻性的个体被假定会根据其对未来劳动力市场风险的主观信念来调整消费和劳动供给决策。本文利用丰富的面板数据，记录了收入增长预期以及自愿和非自愿离职感知可能性中显著的个体异质性。我们考察了预期如何随工作生涯和商业周期演变，以及它们如何与宏观经济预期和个人经历共变。虽然大体上与已实现结果中的模式一致，但我们的发现强调了疫情衰退及其随之而来的辞职潮的意外性质。

articles.title_en: Family Income Dynamics 1970–2018: Putting the Pieces Together
articles.title_cn: 家庭收入动态（1970-2018）：拼图整合
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the driving forces of family income dynamics by developing a unified framework to estimate permanent and transitory variation in head earnings, spouse earnings, and transfer income, as well as permanent and transitory correlations between these income sources. A complete decomposition using the PSID 1970–2018 shows that transitory variation in head earnings alone accounts for more than half of the total family income inequality. Insurance against transitory shocks to head earnings comes primarily from transfer income rather than spouse earnings. Both permanent and transitory variations in spouse earnings have an equalizing effect on family income inequality.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过构建一个统一框架来估计户主收入、配偶收入和转移收入的永久性与暂时性变动，以及这些收入来源之间的永久性和暂时性相关性，从而考察家庭收入动态的驱动因素。利用PSID（1970-2018）数据进行完整分解显示，仅户主收入的暂时性变动就占家庭总收入不平等的超过一半。对户主收入暂时性冲击的保险主要来自转移收入而非配偶收入。配偶收入的永久性和暂时性变动对家庭收入不平等均具有均等化效应。

articles.title_en: The Association between the Volatility of Income and Life Expectancy in the United States
articles.title_cn: 美国收入波动性与预期寿命之间的关联
articles.abstract_en: We examine the relationship between income volatility and life expectancy in mid-sized U.S. commuting zones between 2006 and 2014. We use a commercial dataset, InfoUSA, to measure income volatility which we link to estimates of life expectancy by gender, county, race, and income. We find that higher income volatility in a county is associated with lower life expectancy, but only at the bottom of the income distribution and primarily for non-Hispanic Whites. Though we cannot extrapolate our findings to individual-level relationships, we do link them to existing literatures on place-based differences in mortality and the relationship between volatility and health.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了2006年至2014年间美国中等规模通勤区收入波动性与预期寿命之间的关系。我们使用商业数据集InfoUSA来衡量收入波动性，并将其与按性别、县、种族和收入划分的预期寿命估计值相关联。我们发现，一个县较高的收入波动性与较低的预期寿命相关，但仅限于收入分配底端，且主要针对非西班牙裔白人。尽管我们无法将我们的发现外推到个体层面的关系，但我们确实将其与关于死亡率地区差异以及波动性与健康之间关系的现有文献联系起来。

articles.title_en: Robust Inference for the Frisch Labor Supply Elasticity
articles.title_cn: 弗里施劳动供给弹性的稳健推断
articles.abstract_en: Many studies estimate the Frisch elasticity via two-stage least squares (2SLS) regression of hours changes on wage changes. However, 2SLS suffers from a power asymmetry problem that makes estimates far away from ordinary least squares appear spuriously imprecise. Hence, it is difficult for t-tests to detect a positive Frisch elasticity. We illustrate the problem using NLSY97 data. We estimate an elasticity of 0.60 for young men, but the t-test indicates that it is insignificant. The Anderson-Rubin (AR) test, which avoids the power asymmetry problem, indicates that it is highly significant. We argue that the AR test should be widely adopted in lieu of the t-test in instrumental variable applications.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多研究通过两阶段最小二乘（2SLS）回归小时变化对工资变化来估计弗里施弹性。然而，2SLS存在功效不对称问题，使得远离普通最小二乘的估计显得虚假地不精确。因此，t检验难以检测到正的弗里施弹性。我们使用NLSY97数据说明了这一问题。我们估计年轻男性的弹性为0.60，但t检验表明其不显著。Anderson-Rubin（AR）检验避免了功效不对称问题，表明其高度显著。我们认为，在工具变量应用中，应广泛采用AR检验替代t检验。

articles.title_en: Distributional Effects of Local Minimum Wages: A Spatial Job Search Approach
articles.title_cn: 地方最低工资的分配效应：一种空间工作搜寻方法
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a spatial general equilibrium job search model to study the effects of local and universal minimum wage policies on employment, wages, job postings, vacancies, migration, and welfare. Workers search for jobs locally and in neighboring areas, deciding whether to migrate or commute after receiving remote offers. The model, estimated using ACS and QWI data, reliably forecasts commuting responses to city minimum wage hikes. Simulations show that low-skill (noncollege) workers benefit from local wage increases up to $12.50. The greatest per capita welfare gain for all workers is achieved by a $15.25 universal minimum wage.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一个空间一般均衡工作搜寻模型，以研究地方性和普遍性最低工资政策对就业、工资、职位发布、空缺、迁移和福利的影响。工人在本地和邻近地区搜寻工作，在收到远程录用通知后决定是迁移还是通勤。该模型使用ACS和QWI数据进行估计，能够可靠地预测城市最低工资上调的通勤反应。模拟显示，低技能（非大学）工人从最高$12.50的地方工资增长中受益。所有工人的人均福利最大增益通过$15.25的普遍最低工资实现。

articles.title_en: The Impact of the Level and Timing of Parental Resources on Child Development and Intergenerational Mobility
articles.title_cn: 父母资源水平与时机对儿童发展和代际流动的影响
articles.abstract_en: This study explores relationships between parental resource trajectories and child development and their implications for intergenerational mobility. By modifying the child skill formation technology to incorporate new skills emerging during adolescence, we analyze the importance of the timing of family resources on life outcomes, educational attainment, and participation in crime. Parental financial resources partially offset deficiencies in nonpecuniary inputs to children’s human capital. Estimates of the intergenerational influence on child outcomes are strongly influenced by the choice of lifetime versus snapshot parental income measures. The most predictive ages of children when family resources are measured vary by the outcome analyzed.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了父母资源轨迹与儿童发展之间的关系及其对代际流动的影响。通过修改儿童技能形成技术，纳入青春期出现的新技能，我们分析了家庭资源时机对生活结果、教育成就和犯罪参与的重要性。父母的经济资源部分抵消了儿童人力资本中非货币投入的不足。对儿童结果的代际影响的估计受到选择终身还是快照父母收入测量的强烈影响。家庭资源测量时儿童最具预测性的年龄因分析的结果而异。

articles.title_en: A Generalized Model of Misclassification Errors and Labor Force Dynamics
articles.title_cn: 误分类错误与劳动力动态的广义模型
articles.abstract_en: We study the US labor market transitions using a latent variable approach, explicitly modeling the persistent misclassification process and the non-Markovian nature of the underlying true labor force dynamics. A closed-form global identification for misclassification probabilities and labor transition probabilities is established through an eigenvalue-eigenvector decomposition. Contrary to existing studies, our empirical results suggest that the observed data have understated the true mobility in labor force statuses after we account for persistence in both the misclassification errors and the latent true labor force dynamics.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用潜在变量方法研究美国劳动力市场转换，明确建模了持续性的误分类过程和潜在真实劳动力动态的非马尔可夫性质。通过特征值-特征向量分解，建立了误分类概率和劳动力转换概率的闭式全局识别。与现有研究相反，我们的实证结果表明，在考虑了误分类错误和潜在真实劳动力动态的持续性后，观测数据低估了劳动力状态的真实流动性。

articles.title_en: Inference with Imputed Data: The Allure of Making Stuff Up
articles.title_cn: 基于插补数据的推断：虚构数据的诱惑
articles.abstract_en: Incomplete observability of data generates an identification problem. What one can learn about a population parameter depends on the assumptions one finds credible. Rubin has promoted random multiple imputation (RMI) as a general way to deal with missing values. The recommendation has been influential to researchers who seek a simple fix to the nuisance of missing data. This paper provides a transparent assessment of the mix of Bayesian and frequentist thinking used by Rubin to argue for RMI. It evaluates random imputation to replace missing outcome or covariate data when the objective is to learn a conditional expectation.
articles.abstract_cn: 数据的不完全可观测性产生了识别问题。关于总体参数能学到什么，取决于人们认为可信的假设。Rubin 推广了随机多重插补（RMI）作为处理缺失值的一般方法。这一建议对那些寻求简单解决缺失数据问题的研究者具有影响力。本文对Rubin用来论证RMI的贝叶斯与频率学派思想的混合进行了透明的评估。当目标是学习条件期望时，本文评估了用随机插补来替代缺失的结果或协变量数据的效果。

articles.title_en: Family Law Effects on Divorce, Fertility, and Child Investment
articles.title_cn: 家庭法对离婚、生育和子女投资的影响
articles.abstract_en: To assess the child welfare impact of policies governing divorced parenting, such as child support orders, child custody assignments, and marital dissolution standards, one must consider their influence not only on the divorce rate but also on spouses’ fertility choices and child investments. We develop a model of fertility, parenting, and divorce, from which we derive estimates of parental preferences and a child cognitive ability production function, using data on parental time allocation, children’s cognitive attainment, and realized fertility and divorce. Family policies that reduce divorce are simulated to have significant negative impacts on both fertility and child development.
articles.abstract_cn: 为了评估管理离异父母育儿政策（如子女抚养令、子女监护权分配和婚姻解除标准）对儿童福利的影响，必须考虑这些政策不仅对离婚率的影响，还包括对配偶生育选择和子女投资的影响。我们开发了一个关于生育、育儿和离婚的模型，从中利用父母时间分配、儿童认知成就以及实际生育和离婚的数据，估计出父母偏好和儿童认知能力生产函数。模拟显示，减少离婚的家庭政策对生育和儿童发展均有显著的负面影响。

articles.title_en: Changing Families: Family Relationships, Parental Decisions, and Child Development
articles.title_cn: 变化中的家庭：家庭关系、父母决策与儿童发展
articles.abstract_en: We develop a tractable economic framework to study the impact of family structure on children’s cognitive and noncognitive outcomes. Combining a sequential choice model with panel data on both biological parents, irrespective of subsequent relationship status, and on social fathers and a set of exclusion restrictions, we identify the unobserved heterogeneity of biological families and examine child skill formation via a control function approach. Time investments made by high-ability fathers have positive returns, whereas those made by low-ability fathers can generate negative returns. Policies that incentivize family formation should consider the quality of the fathers whom mothers are cohabited with.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个易于处理的经济框架，研究家庭结构对儿童认知和非认知结果的影响。结合序贯选择模型与关于亲生父母（不论其后续关系状态如何）及社会父亲的面板数据，并利用一组排除限制，我们识别了亲生家庭的未观测异质性，并通过控制函数方法考察儿童技能形成。高能力父亲的时间投入具有正回报，而低能力父亲的时间投入可能产生负回报。激励家庭形成的政策应考虑母亲同居父亲的质量。
